While you are away

Boarding kennels

Kennels for dogs of all sizes, from a blind bull terrier to a German shepherd, as owners describe. Kennels come up in 6 reviews.

Cattery

Boarding kennels and cattery, as the sign at the gate says. On Instagram the kennels call themselves the first EU licensed kennels.

Care and attention

Owners write that their dogs get excited when they arrive and run in to say hi, and that they always trust the team with the best care and attention.

What owners say
